hypothesis: The current state vector mixes falling, stabilizing, turning and re-accelerating pullbacks. Explicit causal phase/turn interactions plus a direct cost-cover ranking objective can separate profitable executable entry states better than the same-capacity baseline feature set.
target: enter_3m_event_base_pct > 0 using Request215 event-time executable outcome semantics

models.baseline: same HistGradientBoostingClassifier capacity using the frozen pre-217 feature family
models.phase: same classifier capacity plus preregistered causal pullback phase/turn features

training_weight: equalized by trading-day and target class so rare positive states cannot be erased by the negative majority
calibration: Platt calibration on the calibration block only
selection: first recurrent state per episode crossing the 90th percentile of that model's calibration probability distribution
cross_sectional_audit: among above-threshold states observed in the same real clock minute, retain the highest phase probability and then the first leader per episode
forbidden: future next-event timing as a feature
using event-time outcome columns as features
claiming overlapping watch-state AUC is an end-to-end trading result
